purpose: Navigates to another page or resource. Inline links sit in running text; standalone links stand on their own, for example in lists.

props.name: children
props.description: Link text that says where it goes

props.name: variant
props.description: Inline is always underlined; standalone underlines on hover. Defaults to inline

props.name: external
props.description: Opens in a new tab with an icon and the text (opens in a new tab)

whenToUse: To go to another page or resource
Inside text to point to related content
whenNotToUse: To perform an action on this page — use Button
For tabs, breadcrumbs or the side navigation — use those components
antiPatterns: Link text such as 'click here' that does not say where it goes
Styling a link as a button

anatomy: Text in the link colour, underlined inline; external links end with an open_in_new icon
sizes: Inherits the surrounding text size; icon `size-icon-sm`
typography: Inline inherits the text; standalone `type-label-family` at `type-label-weight`
states: `color-text-link`, `color-text-link-hover` on hover with a thicker underline; focus ring `color-interactive-focus-ring`

a11yNotes: A native link; Enter follows it
Inline links are underlined so they are not identified by colour alone (WCAG 1.4.1)
External links announce that they open a new tab
